mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_value_report WHERE deleted = FALSE AND report_period LIKE #{yearPrefix} || '%' ORDER BY report_period DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM biz_value_report WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_value_report ( report_period, efficiency_gain, quality_gain, cost_saving, cost_saving_unit, demand_ids, case_ids, description, created_by) VALUES ( #{reportPeriod}, #{efficiencyGain}, #{qualityGain}, #{costSaving}, #{costSavingUnit}, #{demandIds, typeHandler=com.aiacademy.business.demand.repository.JsonLongListTypeHandler}, #{caseIds, typeHandler=com.aiacademy.business.demand.repository.JsonLongListTypeHandler}, #{description}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_value_report SET report_period = #{reportPeriod}, efficiency_gain = #{efficiencyGain}, quality_gain = #{qualityGain}, cost_saving = #{costSaving}, cost_saving_unit = #{costSavingUnit}, demand_ids = #{demandIds, typeHandler=com.aiacademy.business.demand.repository.JsonLongListTypeHandler}, case_ids = #{caseIds, typeHandler=com.aiacademy.business.demand.repository.JsonLongListTypeHandler}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_value_report WHERE deleted = FALSE AND report_period LIKE #{yearPrefix} || '%' AND efficiency_gain IS NOT NULL AND efficiency_gain <> ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_value_report WHERE deleted = FALSE AND report_period LIKE #{yearPrefix} || '%' AND quality_gain IS NOT NULL AND quality_gain <> ''

SELECT cost_saving_unit AS unit, COALESCE(SUM(cost_saving), 0) AS total FROM biz_value_report WHERE deleted = FALSE AND report_period LIKE #{yearPrefix} || '%' AND cost_saving IS NOT NULL AND cost_saving_unit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cost_saving_unit
